'''Corellia Sector Newsfeed''' was the preeminent news organization in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. Following the declaration of ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]'' by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], CSN interviewed [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diktat]] [[Shyla Merricope]] to get her take on the turn of events.
